parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the Event-triggered Alert Rule.

parameters.name: EventPattern
parameters.description: The pattern of the Event-triggered Alert Rule.

sub_parameters.name: CustomFilters
sub_parameters.description: The keyword for event filtering. When the event content contains this keyword, an alert is automatically triggered.

sub_parameters.name: EventTypeList
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 50. Valid values:

- StatusNotification: fault notification.

- Exception: exception.

- Maintenance: O&M.

- \*: unlimited.

sub_parameters.name: LevelList
sub_parameters.description:
The level of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 50. Valid values:

- CRITICAL: critical.

- WARN: warning.

- INFO: information.

- \*: all levels.

sub_parameters.name: NameList
sub_parameters.description: The name of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

sub_parameters.name: Product
sub_parameters.description:
The Alibaba Cloud service type. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

>For information about the Alibaba Cloud services supported by Event-triggered Alert Rules, see [DescribeSystemEventMetaList](~~114972~~).

sub_parameters.name: SQLFilter
sub_parameters.description:
The SQL filter for events. When the event content meets the SQL condition, an alert is automatically triggered.
> The syntax of the SQL event filter is consistent with the query syntax of Simple Log Service (SLS).

sub_parameters.name: StatusList
sub_parameters.description: The status of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: EventType
parameters.description:
The type of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values:

- SYSTEM: system event.
- CUSTOM: custom event.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the application group to which the Event-triggered Alert Rule belongs.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the Event-triggered Alert Rule.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description:
The status of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values:

- ENABLED: enabled.
- DISABLED: disabled.
